zh: 以下书目未收入古典时代的通行文本。为方便有意查阅的读者，只要有英译本，我就会列出，即使并未直接引用。多卷本中的某一卷用“v.”标明，总卷数用“vols.”标明。“Ed.”只表示该版本收录原文，未必是最新的校勘本，尽管往往确实如此。拜占庭作者按姓氏或第二名字母排序，以名字为世所熟知者及皇帝除外。
en: The following bibliography does not include standard texts from classical antiquity. I cite English translations where available, for the convenience of the interested reader even when I have not quoted from them directly. I use “v.” to designate specific volumes within a multivolume publication, and “vols.” to designate the total number of volumes. “Ed.” means only that the publication contains the original text, not necessarily the most recent critical edition (though often that is the case). Byzantine authors are listed by their family or second names, unless they are conventionally known by their first names or are emperors.
